name: Cold Brew Concentrate
summary: Long, low-temperature steep that produces a smooth, low-acid concentrate for diluting with water or milk.

steps.title: Combine
steps.instruction: Add coarsely ground coffee to your jar, then pour in the water and stir to fully saturate all grounds.

steps.title: Steep
steps.instruction: Cover and let steep at room temperature or in the fridge.
steps.tip: 12–16 hours is the typical range — longer steeps taste stronger and slightly more bitter.

steps.title: Strain
steps.instruction: Strain through a fine mesh strainer, then again through a paper filter for a cleaner cup.

steps.title: Dilute and serve
steps.instruction: This is a concentrate — dilute roughly 1:1 with water or milk over ice before drinking.
